patterns: APPSC Group-1 asks a multi-statement item on Late Harappan features: Chalcolithic, no complicated casting, village life; Bhagwanpura burnt-brick trap.
Other PSCs test theory-proponent pairs (Wheeler = Aryan invasion) and the IIT Kharagpur 900-year low-rainfall study.
Late Harappan site-to-region items (Dadheri = Punjab) appear in UPPSC; numbers 900 / 4.2 ka / 200 years are easily confused.
App goes far deeper (Deoria Tal pollen, Rakhigarhi DNA, continuity debate) than the PYQs; many statement-heavy items.
